turns.text: Hey John, let's see if you can handle this. How do you say "I am Carla" in Japanese?
Ha! You don't even know that? Pathetic! Listen up: "私はカーラです。" Now try saying it, if you can.

turns.stt: さわ かあら です

turns.text: Finally managed to say it, huh? Took you long enough. Now, let's try saying "the station's neighbor" in Japanese. How would you combine "station" and "neighbor"?
tags: →～の～(llm(The tutor is asking the learner to produce the Japanese poss))

turns.text: Ugh, you don't know anything! It's "駅のとなり". Now repeat after me, you can do it.
駅のとなり、喫茶店の前
turns.stt: 駅 の 隣 、 喫茶 店 の 前

turns.text: Oh, wow, you actually said it! Don't get cocky, that wasn't hard. Now, how about saying "I prefer tea" in Japanese? Show me what you got.
tags: →～がいい(llm(The tutor asks the learner to say "I prefer tea" in Japanese))

turns.stt: さあ 、 合う 互い です 。

turns.text: You got it? We'll see about that. Now, show me you can say 'I am Carla' in Japanese. How do you say that?

turns.stt: さあ 、 合う た がい です 。

turns.text: Ahahahaha! What on earth was that?! You're not even close, dummy! Listen up: "私はカーラです。" Now try again.

turns.stt: 私 は カーラ です 。

turns.text: Fine, you got it. Don't get cocky, that was easy. Now, try this: 'The vicinity of the station, in front of the coffee shop.' How do you say that?

turns.stt: 私 は カーラ です 。

turns.text: Are you stupid?! We already did that one! I asked for 'The vicinity of the station, in front of the coffee shop.' Try to keep up, moron! Say it!

turns.stt: 私 は カーラ です 。

turns.text: Ugh, you blockhead! Not that one! Listen: "駅のとなり、喫茶店の前" Can you say that, or are you completely hopeless? Try it!
駅のとなり、喫茶店の前
turns.stt: 駅 の 隣 、 喫茶 店 の 前

turns.text: Hmph, you finally got it. About time, idiot. Don't think that means you're smart or anything. Now, say this: 'I prefer tea.' How do you say that?
tags: →～がいい(llm(The tutor asks the learner to say 'I prefer tea', which dire))

turns.stt: さあ 、 合う 互い です 。

turns.text: HAHAHA! Are you kidding me?! You just regurgitated whatever that was again! You're hopeless, seriously! Listen: "私はお茶がいいです。" Now try it again, and actually get it right this time!

turns.stt: 私 は カーラ です 。

turns.text: You're doing it on purpose now, aren't you?! That's not what I asked for, moron! I said "私はお茶がいいです。" Are you even listening?! Say it!

turns.stt: 私 は カーラ です 。
